This API is used to enable or disable SQL Explorer. After this function is enabled, the instance performance loss is within 5%. Enabling SQL Explorer will allow DAS to store all SQL statement logs for analysis. You can set the retention period of SQL explorer data. After the retention period expires, the data is automatically deleted. If not specified, the data is retained for seven days. This API is used to enable or disable Slow Query Log. If not specified, the data is retained for seven days. Only paid instances are supported.

This API is used to add a concurrency control rule of SQL statements. Only MySQL and PostgreSQL databases are supported. Restrictions: 1. Take select~a as an example. "select" and "a" are the two keywords contained in the concurrency control rule. The keywords are separated by a tilde (~). In this example, to trigger this concurrency rule, keywords select and a must be contained in the SQL command. 2. If a SQL statement matches multiple concurrency control rules, only the most recently added rule is applied. 3. Keywords in a concurrency control rule are sorted in a specific order, and the system will match them from first to last. For example, if one rule contains the keyword a~and~b, the system only matches xxx a>1 and b>2. 4. Generated keywords may be case-sensitive. Execute **"show variables like 'rds_sqlfilter_case_sensitive'** or go to the parameter setting page for specifying case-sensitivity. 5. Concurrency control rules can only be added for primary instances. 6. System catalogs are not restricted, queries which involve data are not restricted, and the root account is not restricted in specific versions.

This API is used to obtain the space analysis data list. The file system generated instance-level data, and the **information_schema.tables** table generates database-level and table-level data. **Space & Metadata Analysis** allows you to analyze a maximum of 10,000 tables. If tablespace data is missing, there may be too many instance tables, or the account password has not been saved. If the account password has not been saved, use the user management interface or page to save the database account. MySQL, GaussDB(for MySQL) and SQLServer are supported.
